import os as _os, re as _re
import sys as _sys
import argparse as _argparse

_cli = _argparse.ArgumentParser(description='生成打新底仓最终组合与面板配置')
_cli.add_argument('base', nargs='?', default='2026-11-06')
_cli.add_argument('--market-shares', default=None,
                  help='四档沪市占比，逗号分隔；省略时沿用50,55,60,63')
_cli_args = _cli.parse_args()
BASE = _cli_args.base
if _cli_args.market_shares is None:
    MARKET_SHARES = [50, 55, 60, 63]
else:
    try:
        MARKET_SHARES = [int(x.strip()) for x in _cli_args.market_shares.split(',')]
    except ValueError:
        _cli.error('--market-shares 只能是四个整数')
    _steps = [b - a for a, b in zip(MARKET_SHARES, MARKET_SHARES[1:])]
    if (len(MARKET_SHARES) != 4 or len(set(MARKET_SHARES)) != 4
            or any(x <= 0 or x >= 100 for x in MARKET_SHARES)
            or not (all(x > 0 for x in _steps) or all(x < 0 for x in _steps))):
        _cli.error('--market-shares 必须是四个互异、递增或递减的1至99整数')

_MEMBER_FILE = f'打新底仓_成员权重_{BASE}.csv'
